title: The old examples as a type for warning the Corinthians
english: In these verses Paul wants to instruct them in what is fitting by setting the ancients beside them, showing that those people too experienced events that served as types. For since the example appeared so suitable, he was found to be right in advising them not to commit similar offenses, so that they would not suffer similar things. Their being under the cloud, then, was a clear sign of the grace of the Spirit. For just as the cloud overshadowed those people and delivered them from harm by the Egyptians, so grace rescues us from demonic evil.
